en.answer:
In this case, <<16390>> will not be Special Summoned either. (<<16390>> remains in your hand.)

However, even in that case, the effect that prevents you from Special Summoning monsters from your Extra Deck, except Xyz Monsters, is still applied.
en.question: I activate the effect of <<16390>> in my hand, targeting a "Lyrilusc" monster in my Graveyard. What happens if that targeted monster is no longer in the Graveyard when the effect resolves?
en.title: What happens if the monster targeted with the effect of <<16390>> is no longer in the Graveyard when that effect resolves?

ja.answer:
その場合、「<<16390>>」も特殊召喚されません。（その「<<16390>>」は手札に残ります。）

なお、その場合でも『この効果の発動後、ターン終了時まで自分はXモンスターしかEXデッキから特殊召喚できない』効果は適用されます。
